name: MakeMyTrip

SDE-1.dsaDepth: Moderate - OA (HackerEarth: 2 coding + 20 CS-fundamentals MCQs) then a DSA round and an OOD/system-design round
rounds: Online assessment (HackerEarth, ~90 min): 2 coding questions (easy–moderate: DP, graph, binary search) plus 20 MCQs on DBMS/OS/CN/SQL/OOPs
Round 1 - DSA (1 hr): 2 problems, often backtracking/recursion variants (e.g. a constrained combination-sum, sort-an-array-using-only-recursion)
Round 2 - Design/OOSD (1 hr): resume and internship deep-dive, then an OOP design problem (e.g. elevator-management system with an ER diagram) and OOP fundamentals (polymorphism, abstract classes)
Round 3 - Managerial: project discussion, sometimes one more DSA question
extraTopics: OOP design fundamentals - several reports describe candidates being rejected specifically for weak OOD, even with correct DSA
Being able to design AND reason about a system on the spot, not just recite definitions
